one_liner: Gladly has a broad documented REST API with Basic auth (agent email + API token), but accounts are sales/demo-gated with no free tier, so access needs a customer or sales conversation.
auth_notes: API tokens are generated by a user with the API User permission and used as the Basic auth password with the agent email as username. Tokens are tied to a single user and environment (sandbox vs production). The Lookup API uses HMAC-SHA256 request signing, but that is for Gladly calling the customer's service, not for third-party client access. No OAuth2 is documented.
access_notes: No free tier or self-serve signup. Gladly typically requires a demo and custom pricing. API tokens come from a paying customer's Gladly instance, and an admin must create an API-role user per integration. A sandbox environment exists but is obtained by contacting Gladly.
blocker_notes: No self-serve or free path to credentials. A test instance needs a demo or sales request. In production, each customer admin must create an API user and token, so setup is per-customer.

evidence.quote: Select **Basic** as the Authorization Type. Enter your username (your Gladly login email) and Password (the Gladly API token you just generated).
API tokens are tied to a single user account and a particular environment.
